        assert False, "Expected ValueError"
    except ValueError:

    Version = semver.version.Version
    try:
        Version.parse("1.2.3\\n")
        assert False, "Expected ValueError"
    except ValueError:
        pass

def test_bump_build_non_numeric_appends_zero():
    """bump_build must append '.0' when the last build segment is not numeric."""

    assert bumped.build == "build.10"
